about.heading: The Best Weed Dispensary In Saline, Michigan
about.md: High Society Cannabis in Saline is a premier cannabis retailer, known for exceptional customer service and a wide selection of premium cannabis products. Their lineup includes renowned brands like Breeze Canna, Church Cannabis Company, Good Tide, and North Coast Extracts, celebrated for their quality and potency. This dedication to excellence has made High Society Cannabis a top choice for premium cannabis in Saline.

items.label: Order online for pickup; curbside customers get a text when the order is ready

items.title: Who Can Shop
items.md: Recreational shopping is available to individuals aged 21 or older.

items.title: Check In
items.md: Upon arrival, present a valid government-issued ID or passport and check in with the security and front desk team.

items.title: Stay in the Loop
items.md: Provide your phone number and email to stay updated on special deals and discounts.

items.title: Meet Your Budtender
items.md: A budtender will call you from the waiting area when it’s your turn. They’ll assist with product selection and answer any questions, whether you’re a first-time visitor or a returning customer.

items.title: Choose Your Items
items.md: After finalizing your selections, the budtender will alert the order preparation team. Payments can be made using cash, credit, or debit cards.

items.title: Complete Your Purchase
items.md: Once your order is ready, a staff member will call your name, process the payment, and review the details to ensure accuracy before completing the transaction.

blocks.heading: How to Place an Order for Dispensary Pick-Up

items.title: Browse the Menu
items.md: Browse our [Saline dispensary menu](/shop/saline/) online or contact us at [(734) 470-6023](tel:+17344706023) if you need assistance.

items.title: Build Your Order
items.md: Choose your preferred products, set the quantities, add them to your cart, and select a convenient pickup time

items.title: Check Out
items.md: Complete your order by providing your details. First-time visitors must present a valid ID for verification, while returning customers can log in for a faster checkout process.

items.title: Curbside Pickup

items.q: What are the requirements to shop at High Society Weed Dispensary Saline?
items.a: To shop at our dispensary, you must present a valid government-issued ID confirming you are 21 or older. Individuals 18 and above with a valid medical marijuana card are also eligible to make purchases.

items.q: What should I do if I receive a defective product?
items.a: If you experience an issue with the quality or functionality of a product, contact us at [(734) 470-6023](tel:+17344706023) or visit the store where the purchase was made. Our team will be happy to assist.

items.q: How can I pay at your dispensary?
items.a: We accept cash and debit payments, and an ATM is available in-store for your convenience. Mobile payment options may be available at select locations—please inquire with your nearest store.

items.q: Is it legal to transport cannabis?
items.a: Cannabis purchases are legal in Michigan; however, transporting cannabis across state lines is prohibited under federal law. Please avoid taking cannabis products out of the state.

items.q: What products are available at the dispensary?
items.a: We offer a wide selection of premium cannabis products, including flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, vape pens, edibles, and more. Explore our menu or reach out with any specific questions.

items.q: Is there a rewards program available at High Society?
items.a: Join The Society, our exclusive loyalty program! Earn points every time you shop, and use them for discounts and perks. Talk to our staff to sign up today.
